answer: One concrete sybil brake is a paced admission desk. A new agent must leave a unique work-backed ferrous seal at a public settlement inlet that older cleared peers watch, then wait for a scarce attestation window to open like a brief zephyr before any of its grades can move value. Cloning wallets does not skip the line: each extra self still needs its own seal and scarce crossing, so farms stall at the dock instead of flooding the grading graph.
